rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for using money, resources, or skills for a particular purpose.

example.english: We need to apply this money to staff training.
example.traditional: 呢筆錢要用喺員工培訓度。
example.jyutping: ni1 bat1 cin2 jiu3 jung6 hai2 jyun4 gung1 pui4 fan3 dou6

rows.note: Use this when submitting yourself as a candidate for a job or other position.

example.english: I want to apply for a summer job.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 san1 cing2 fan6 syu2 kei4 gung1

rows.note: Use this for putting cream, ointment, or another substance onto the skin or a surface.

example.english: Remember to apply this ointment before bed.
example.traditional: 記住瞓覺前搽呢支藥膏。
example.jyutping: gei3 zyu6 fan3 gaau3 cin4 caa4 ni1 zi1 joek6 gou1

rows.note: Use this when a rule, condition, or principle is applicable to a person or situation.

example.english: This rule will apply to all residents.
example.traditional: 呢項規定適用於所有住戶。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 kwai1 ding6 sik1 jung6 jyu1 so2 jau5 zyu6 wu6
